content.title: 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Inductees, Start Time & How to Watch
content.text: Before tonight’s WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony, Ryan Wohl breaks down viewing information and the Inductees. Throughout the years, the WWE Hall of Fame Induction Ceremonyopens in a new tab has been a staple of WrestleManiaopens in a new tab weekend, and this will be the 23rd consecutive one. The WWE introduced the Hall of Fame event in 1993 and ran it until 1996, then put it on hiatus. Check out the viewing information and the Inductees in this year’s WWE Hall of Fame class. 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Inductees Individuals Stephanie McMahon AJ Styles Tag Team Demolition Legacy Sid Celebrity Dennis Rodman Immortal Moment: Hulk Hogan vs. Andre the Giant at WrestleMania III How to Watch 2026 WWE Hall of Fame The Red Carpet for this year’s WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony begins at 8:15 p.m. PT/11:15 p.m. ET on WWE’s YouTube channel. At 9:00 p.m. PT/12:00 a.m. ET, the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony begins on ESPN Unlimited. 2026 WWE Hall of Fame: FAQ Where will the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony take place? The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony is taking place at Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas, Nevada. When is the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony taking place? This year’s WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony is occurring on Friday, April 17. What time does the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony start? The 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony begins at 9:00 p.m. PT and 12:00 a.m. ET. The Red Carpet starts at 8:15 p.m. PT and 11:15 p.m. ET. How can I watch the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony? This year’s WWE Hall of Fame Ceremony airs live on ESPN Unlimited.
